rachats.citation: Lonza has paid €100 million ($107 million) upfront to acquire Dutch firm Synaffix, adding an ADC technology platform and R&D capabilities, including payload and site-specific linker technology. A further €60 million could be laid out based on additional performance-based consideration.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
